FOREWORD

`Dental vocabulary - Part 5 Terms This Indian Standard, which is identical with IS0 1942-5 Organization for Standardization, issued by the International associated with testing', was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on the recommendation of the Dentistry ~o;tio;lal Committee and approval of the Medical Equipment and Hospital Planning Division . The text of the above mentioned IS0 Standard has been approved as suitable for publication as Indian Standard without deviations. Certain terminology and conventions are, however, not identical to those used in Indian Standards. Attention is particularly drawn to the following: Standard' appear a) Wherever the words `International should be read as `Indian Standard'. referring to this standard, they

b) Comma ( , ) has been used as a decimal marker while in Indian Standards, the current practice is to use a point ( . ) as the decimal marker. The following international standards referred to in the foot-notes do not have the identical or technically equivalent Indian Standards: IS0 664 : 1973 Plastics Determination of compressive IS0 857 : 1979 Definitions of welding processes IS0 6892 : 1984 Metallic Materials - Tensile testing The technical committee responsible for the preparation of this standard has reviewed the provisions of the above-mentioned IS0 Standards and has decided that they are acceptable for use in conjunction with this standard. This standard under the general title parts in this series are as follows: Part 1 General and clinical Part 2 Dental materials Part 3 Dental instruments Part 4 Dental equipment Only the English language text of the International been adopted in this Indian Standard. Standard ( including alphabetical index ) has z `Dental Vocabulary' is being published in five parts. Other of the text of this standard
